descriptions.normal: A soft, glutinous snack. Glutinous rice has been grown into powder and rolled into a ball before being steamed. The Sakura Bloom and Snapdragon colors lend an extra liveliness to these dango.
descriptions.suspicious: A soft, glutinous snack. One suspects a lack of water used in the cooking process as the culprit in the cracks all over this dish. Don't force it down your throat, or you just might choke...
descriptions.delicious: A soft, glutinous snack. The luster of these dango is like the falling morning dew, and it gives off the feeling of lush flowers and branches. When watching the flowers, the snack gives one a sense of happiness, as if the whole following year shall be as gorgeous as the falling flowers before them.

effectTexts.normal: Restores 32% of Max HP and an additional 1250 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.suspicious: Restores 30% of Max HP and an additional 600 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.delicious: Restores 34% of Max HP and an additional 1900 HP to the selected character.
